drills.title: Crosscourt Rhythm
drills.description: Play forehand and backhand crosscourt, recovering between your shots.

drills.title: Crosscourt serve returns
drills.description: Read the opening serve and send your return deep crosscourt.

drills.title: Two crosscourt, then line
drills.description: Build two forehands crosscourt, change down the line, then finish on the backhand.

drills.title: Return and close
drills.description: Return the opening serve, approach, and close for a volley.

drills.title: Two volleys and overhead
drills.description: Play two volleys, track the opponent’s lob and finish overhead.

drills.title: Depth ladder
drills.description: Vary your crosscourt placement from a short angle to a deep rally ball.

drills.title: Corner switch
drills.description: Move between your forehand and backhand corners, then play through the middle.

drills.title: Short angle and deep reply
drills.description: Create a short angle, recover, and send the next ball deep.

drills.title: Normal and compact serve returns
drills.description: Read different opening serve rhythms before your crosscourt return.

drills.title: Return a left-handed serve
drills.description: Read a left-handed opening serve and play your return to the opposite corner.

drills.title: Second-serve pressure
drills.description: Attack the second serve with a deep player-authored return.

drills.title: Inside-out escape
drills.description: Play through the middle, run around the backhand and change direction with a forehand.

drills.title: Approach and close
drills.description: Play your approach, move forward, then volley into alternating corners.

drills.title: Defend then finish
drills.description: Use your defensive ball to recover before changing direction down the line.

drills.title: Half-volley and close
drills.description: Take the ball just after the bounce, then close for two volleys.

drills.title: Custom starter
drills.description: Assemble your own player shots, opponent responses and court movement.
